rows.claim: SpikingBrain's Qwen2.5-7B to hybrid-linear upcycle costs ~150B tokens (about 2% of from-scratch) on hundreds of MetaX GPUs for 2+ weeks to hold ~90% of base benchmarks: the 'fraction of the data' framing still lands at cluster-class compute.
rows.steal: Before any future upcycle ask, price it against the SpikingBrain 150B-token datum in watch/inbox/spiking_wide/upcycle-economics.md (579 consumer-GPU-days derived) and drop the ask if it cannot beat that by an order of magnitude.
rows.falsifier: A published 7B-class hybrid-linear upcycle reaching ~90% retention on under ~50B tokens on single-node hardware.

rows.claim: Every post-trained linearization loses to the free SWA+4-sinks baseline on long-context recall, so a conversion only earns its surgery by buying constant-state serving, which means the 3:1 hybrid form.
rows.quote: The pure variant is dead-on-arrival against the B11 baseline; only the hybrid survives.
rows.steal: Add an SWA+sinks arm to the GO 2 eval card set so the pruned/healed 7B is scored against R0 (zero-cost incumbent), not just the unpruned teacher.
rows.falsifier: A post-trained linearization beating SWA+4-sinks on needle recall at small windows in our own eval harness.

rows.claim: The planned 12GB GPU is QLoRA-heal capable (7B at 4-bit derives to ~3.5GB of weights from the paper's 17.5GB half-pruned-70B datum), making depth-prune + QLoRA heal on a 7B the only full conversion recipe inside one estate weekend at $0 GPU spend.
rows.quote: This is the DDR3-server plan with an engine: $200 used box + 64GB DDR3 +
rows.steal: When the DDR3 body lands, make its first GPU job the GO 2 run: prune 20-35% of a 7B's layers, QLoRA-heal 5000 steps on 328M tokens, log on-box tok/s to replace the derived 2-3k/s.
rows.falsifier: On-box QLoRA of a 7B exceeding 12GB VRAM or sustaining under ~1k tok/s, collapsing the one-weekend claim to cloud-only.

rows.claim: Kaggle's free ~30 GPU-hour week is the only estate-reachable shape for a LoLCATs-class linearization (6.5 A100-hours published for 8B), and only if the DDR3 body ships a 16GB card; on 12GB or 4GB it is out of shape.

rows.steal: After the DDR3 body confirms its GPU VRAM, book one Kaggle week for the LoLCATs-8B fit test and bank fit-or-OOM as the receipt.
rows.falsifier: LoLCATs-8B training OOMing on a 16GB free-tier card, or exceeding 30 wall-hours there.
